The name is apt; this expansion is indeed unfinished. There was a lot of work visible in it, but the constant freezing and stuttering ruins the experience. It's been reported widely since launch and has never been fixed.

This product is not in a release state. Hopefully it will get the developer attention it needs to be worth attaching a price to for commercial sale, because it's obvious SOMEONE cared, just... not every employee who needed to.

Game started out strong. Cool looking world and gameplay wasn't bad. There just wasn't any development. It was always the same fights. Not much ever changed as far as puzzles or bosses or mechanics. The story also falls really flat. That whole wasteland part is...an interesting choice.

A great follow up from GRIS, with similar art style and lovely OST, with more added combat and more puzzles. This beautiful and emotional game is made even more fun by having a cute yet ferocious companion.

+ Visually stunning.
+ Soundtracks great.
+ you can pet and cuddle Neva anytime

- few boss fights and platforming to get flowers are bothersome/difficult but not a progress breaking

Thanks Nomada Studio and Devolver Digital for this game.

tbh i play this alone since i actually have no friends, but its still fun. yes its harder and sometimes impossible but that doesnt make the fun go away. i enjoy every bit of the game and the updates are worth it

It's 10 euros, 8 rn on sale. Kinda crazy considering the quality of the game. Right now, I'd say let it cook, but still crazy for the money. Game is beautiful, ran it on high with DLSS and frame gen on high FPS. Voice acting is kinda off, especially for the rat.

This game is great. Complete on release and well polished, combat flows nicely and just a well designed game. Great job to the devs! I recommend trying if your an action rpg fan who likes the ebb and flow of fights along with fun abilities. Just a real good game.

I can safely say that "Ori" takes the basic Metroidvania elements, and makes something so creative and unique out of them, that it reaches a level of greatness all its own. A fantastic and touching story, with incredible art, plus really fun and refreshing gameplay mechanics. This game should be the golden standard by which all future 2D games should be judged.  

The Definitive Edition is worth every penny just for the addition of spirit wells (without which I would have lost my mind), but it also adds new areas and abilities, and things to collect throughout the whole world. 

I recommend Ori to absolutely everyone, because if you love games, you'll love Ori. Period!
The film noir style, a realy good sound design and music make a great game. I love the voices of the characters.
When classic boomer shooter is greater than H.P. Lovecraft.

nice short little game for a quick coffee
good potential for future horror games, just needs to be a little longer and the story needs to be a little more complex
last chase scene needs work - the stalker's movements feel too random and unpredictable. when paired with the rng of the key and the lack of hiding spots, it's extremely annoying to get anywhere without dying in two seconds

7/10

that goth chick can ruin me

Holy s**t. Take about a perfect horror game, or just a perfect game in general. I was astounded the first time I played this. It has some of the best visual story telling I've ever seen, and it has zero dialog. It somehow makes you s**t your pants when there aren't even any jumpscares and your not even in a first person view. It has a feeling unlike any game out there. The design of everything: The monsters, the world, the space, is just amazing. If you like horror, or even if you don't, get this game. 10/10

Completely normal game, nothing weird at all!

Five hours into Valor Mortis, and I’m loving it so far. I don’t get the complaints about the combat, it feels great to me. Still early days, but I’m definitely hooked and excited to keep playing.
John Wick the game. 3rd person is way easier than top down even if I like top down view more. No story but fantastic gameplay.

Euphoria mixed with dopamine but you have to walk through hell and lose your mind to get it. Not even joking this made me view life differently and possibly cured my depression (the author of this review is not a doctor and thus should be taken with a grain of salt but it literally changed my world view). I used to quit when things got tough so when I saw only 9.7% completed this game I wanted to try it. This is literally an allegory for life: You try to achieve something nobody else could why they laugh at you and try to stop you from achiving your goal. I am so thankfull for this game!
this game has its moments where it feels like I'm playing bioshock which I love that game so yes I love this game

The bosses are straight up unfair, every time I try to kill them their music starts to pop off and I start instinctively breakdancing in my room. Awful balancing and a fundamentally broken game. 10/10.

The game tells me that I'm supposed to watch my soldiers' stress levels.....

But it feels like, I really should be watching my own stress level when playing this game!

You all still here, nearly ten years later and still no third game, and you want to know why? It is a best game and will forever be, after all, there will be no third game. Play it yourself and see way.

One of the best games ever created just got a perfect remake. This game is the best in the series, with superb story and gameplay spiked with infinite replayability. A must play for everyone who considers themselves a gamer.

At first, the game felt weird, it had no sense... then I find out the game is just a demo for an upcomming title, Bright Memory Infinite. Also I find out, this is a one man project... 

I will be honest, I wasn't expecting this much of fun and quality at all. It worth to try out, graphics are beautiful, sounds and music are fit for the game, gameplay is challanging and you will be more interested in for the upcoming title.

Of course there are some minorr bugs and issues, and you might say that 8 € is too much, but it really worth that money. Quality game!
its good and all it needs more work but its a good game

Finally, a f**cking fishing game that doesn't put you to sleep. Forget sitting by a peaceful lake waiting for a boring-ass bass. In how to fish, you start by crashing your boat into an island because you were probably hammered, and then you immediately grab a shotgun and blast the living sht out of aquatic life. 

This game is completely unhinged. You want to catch fish? Cool, just unload an entire clip into a shrimp, sell it's bloody corpse, and use the cash to buy heavier weapons or gamble away your dignity in a fish casino. Playing with your idiots in co-op makes the chaos even better, especially when you're trying to pull off ridiculous trick shots while fighting bosses across weird islands.

If you are sick of the same repetitive garbage flooding Steam, this is finally something genuinely different, stupid and brilliant. 10/10, would commit fish genocide again.

id rate it mr x/10

Eldest souls is a fast and demanding top-down action game. The game is very enjoyable once you understand its mechanics, it can seem relatively simple at first, but the difficulty increase dramatically when you start adding the restrictions required for 100% completition.

100% steam achievements
Time : 37.9H
Completion Difficulty : 8/10
Playthroughs : 4 minimun
Missables : None
Notable requirements : Complete the game on normal, abyss, no hit for all bosses, no death, no upgrade.

MAGIC MISSILE!! at the top of their lungs, which then turned into everyone absolutely losing their ♥♥♥♥, and laughing as hard as possible. It is a masterpiece, go play it.
Good game, nice pixel art, stays true to T2. Needs more content though for 30$, price is not justified.

A light and airy metroidvania that hits all the right buttons especially for the older and casual gamer. Not too hard, not too easy, and a delight to play. Fans of Deaths Door, Hollow Knight, and the Ori series will love it. Massive thumbs up.
Probably the best friendslop game i have ever played. if you have 2 total dumbasses to play with, then get this game IMMEDIATELY the laughs are so worth it.

A strange woman rambling about astronomical signs approached my house, I denied her entry, she cursed me with having diarrhea. Very next day in the real world, I began suffering from diarrhea. Phenomenal game, 10/10.

Game is pretty fun and makes you feel like you are The Thing devouring the entire base. Only downsides is that there is no map so navigating the base can be a pain when looking for secrets and it is very short game time, took about 6 hours to get 100% in one go.

It's a cool game. I enjoyed it more than I expected. Everything works really well together: the graphics, the gameplay, the story. It's a great complete package. I liked the visual style a lot.

It's quite short for the price thought, so I would recommend getting it on sale. Otherwise, no complaints. Great game!

Even after 10 years, this game beats almost all recent games in terms of replayability, ingame content, quests, story. There's so much to do at all times, I've been playing for 130+ hours and there's still a lot more to do. Not to mention, the Gwent card games add almost 10 hours of gameplay in and of itself. The DLC/ Expansion is very good, amazing storyline, quests, rewards, etc. so I highly suggest getting the complete bundle. Definitely top 3 Open world/ RPG game of all time, hands down. 10/10

Amazing 3rd person game, even in 2026. Campaign is single player, co-op maps are fun, but the MP grind to Rank 200 was a bit of a pain. Still, definitely recommended even just for the story, combat and scenery!
An absolute classic. Multiplayer servers are still up btw.
